entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable!

I can certainly look into that return for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with the product. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

What's the issue? I'll tell you the issue! I went for one ride and they gave me horrible blisters on both heels. And the plate for the cleats feels totally wrong, I couldn't get any power down. I want a full refund, and I want it now.

I'm very sorry to hear that; getting blisters is a terrible experience and certainly not what we want for our customers. Just so I can properly document this, would you say this is a technical fault with the shoe's construction, or more of a preference and fit issue?

Are you listening to me?! It's a garbage product! Stop asking me dumb questions and get me your manager! This is ridiculous. I swear I am going to light you up on every review site if I don't get my money back immediately.

I understand your frustration, sir, and I assure you, there's no need to speak with a manager. I can absolutely handle this for you. Looking at your account, you received the shoes just 8 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy for our cycling shoes. Processing a full refund is not a problem at all.
Oh. So... you're just going to do it? You're giving me the refund?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the process. I am sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file right now. Please pack the shoes back in their box, attach that label, and you can drop it off at any designated shipping center. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method.
Okay. Well... that's fine then. Good. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you quickly. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
